entries.evidenceProves: Spring Boot 3 requires Jakarta EE 9+ servlet APIs; javax.servlet types and the javax.servlet-api dependency must be migrated for a Boot 3 runtime.
entries.testedScenario: OpenRewrite dryRun on isolated copy of spring-migration-case (2026-10-17) patched pom.xml dependency and LegacyServletFilter imports.
entries.reviewerNotes: Static javax.servlet import is necessary-but-not-sufficient evidence; runtime behavior was not executed in DMI API.
entries.nextHumanCheck: After applying jakarta.servlet imports, run application integration tests and servlet filter registration paths.

entries.evidenceProves: javax.annotation.PostConstruct must use jakarta.annotation.PostConstruct under Boot 3 / Jakarta EE 9.
entries.testedScenario: OpenRewrite dryRun patched StartupHook.java PostConstruct import on fixture copy (2026-10-17).
entries.reviewerNotes: CONFIRMED_STATIC pattern match indicates source uses javax annotation; does not alone prove lifecycle hook still required.
entries.nextHumanCheck: Verify @PostConstruct hook behavior after jakarta import and Boot 3 upgrade.

entries.evidenceProves: Explicit ant_path_matcher remains a supported Boot 3 configuration value but opts out of the PathPatternParser default; it signals legacy MVC matching worth reviewing—not automatic breakage.

entries.testedScenario: Static property line in fixture; OpenRewrite UpgradeSpringBoot_3_2 dryRun left application.properties unchanged; no Boot 3 runtime probe executed.
entries.reviewerNotes: Absence from rewrite.patch is not proof OpenRewrite missed a required fix. Runtime URL matching regressions were not reproduced in this batch.
entries.nextHumanCheck: Exercise critical MVC routes after upgrade; drop ant_path_matcher only if PathPatternParser behavior is validated.

entries.evidenceProves: Moving spring-boot-starter-parent 2.7.18→3.2.12 requires coordinated parent, Java baseline, and Jakarta migration work documented for Boot 3.2.
entries.testedScenario: OpenRewrite dryRun updated parent version and java.version on fixture copy; DMI reports POSSIBLE confidence without a source pattern.
entries.reviewerNotes: POSSIBLE static confidence must not be read as confirmed code pattern; parent bump is still required for the requested migration pair.
entries.nextHumanCheck: Align java.version to 17+, run full test suite and dependency alignment after parent upgrade.
